compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The eval harnesses must work for a client project that supplies its own criteria (`.rebar/criteria_routing.json`) and corpus, using the same mechanism rebar uses for its own evals (operator ruling 2026-09-06). Today `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/__main__.py:20-21` hard-codes `_DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR` and `_DEFAULT_OUT_DIR` as CWD-relative `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay[/cache]`; `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/ledger.py:43` `DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH` is a `str` default on `reserve`, `finalize`, `charge_estimate`, `reconcile`, and `print_summary` (`:89,153,185,222,244`) and is re-exported into `tier1.py:390` and `tier2.py:561,684`, with no `--ledger` flag. A client running `python -m rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay` writes into its own `docs/experiments/`. `src/rebar/llm/evals/provider_parity.py:156` globs only packaged specs and `--out` (`:586`) defaults to the packaged results file (`:118,:491`), so a client would write into site-packages. `ledger.py:120` imports `genai_prices` bare although `evals` is a pyproject extra (`pyproject.toml:165-167`) absent from `src/rebar/_optional.py::EXTRAS` (`:35-68`). `AGENTIC_SOLVERS` (`provider_parity.py:88`) still names `"ticket-quality"`, which the LLM-leftovers epic retires. Cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
One resolution rule: `[llm.evals] corpus_root`, read from the reserved `llm` table like `[llm.model_classes]` through `rebar.llm.config_readers._read_llm_file_table` (`src/rebar/llm/config_readers.py:37-63`); default `.rebar/evals`; this repo sets `corpus_root = "docs/experiments"` in `rebar.toml` for now (a sibling story flips it to `evals` when the corpus moves); env `REBAR_LLM_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT`; CLI `rebar -c llm.evals.corpus_root=...`; precedence CLI over env over file over default exactly as `_llm_str_source` (`config_readers.py:66-84`). Relative values resolve against the repo root; harness sub-paths are fixed under it: `<corpus_root>/plan-review-gate/replay/{cache/, ledger.jsonl, tier2-sample.json, <reports>.md}` and `<corpus_root>/provider-parity/provider_parity_results.json`. With `corpus_root = "docs/experiments"` every current literal is reproduced byte-for-byte, so this story lands with zero behaviour change. Choosing the `llm` reserved table rather than a core `_config_schema.py` section keeps this epic out of the config epic's files; the mechanism ratchet censuses core `_SECTIONS` only (`scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_config.py:18-22,37`), so the only new mechanism is the env var, justified at its read site.
- `src/rebar/llm/config_readers.py`: add
```python
DEFAULT_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT = ".rebar/evals"
def evals_corpus_root(repo_root=None) -> Path:
    """[llm.evals].corpus_root: CLI > REBAR_LLM_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT > file > default;
    relative paths resolve against the repo root."""
    root = Path(str(_root_config.repo_root(repo_root)))
    table = _read_llm_file_table(repo_root)
    flat = {"evals.corpus_root": (table.get("evals") or {}).get("corpus_root")}
    cli = _root_config.cli_overrides_for("llm")
    # mechanism-ok: env_var REBAR_LLM_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT — eval corpus root override for client projects
    value = _llm_str(flat, cli, "REBAR_LLM_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT", "evals.corpus_root", DEFAULT_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT)
    return (root / value).resolve() if not Path(value).is_absolute() else Path(value)
```
  plus `replay_dir(repo_root=None) -> Path` (`evals_corpus_root() / "plan-review-gate" / "replay"`) and `default_ledger_path(repo_root=None) -> str` (`replay_dir() / "ledger.jsonl"`). Re-export from `rebar.llm.config` in its re-export block. `-c llm.evals.corpus_root=` works because `set_cli_overrides` splits on the first dot (`src/rebar/config.py:309`).
- `plan_replay/__main__.py`: delete `:20-21`; `--cache-dir`, `--out-dir`, `--sample-path` defaults (`:54-55,72-73,86,96-97`) become `None` and resolve at dispatch to `replay_dir()/"cache"`, `replay_dir()`, `replay_dir()/"tier2-sample.json"`; add `--ledger` (default `None`, resolving to `default_ledger_path()`) threaded into the `tier1.run` and `tier2.run_*` calls.
- `ledger.py`: delete `DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH`; the five `ledger_path: str = DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH` defaults become `str | None = None` with `ledger_path = ledger_path or default_ledger_path()` as the first line; `tier1.py:390`, `tier2.py:561,684` likewise. `ledger.py:120` becomes `genai_prices = guard_import("genai_prices", extra="evals")`.
- `src/rebar/_optional.py` `EXTRAS`: add `"evals": ("genai_prices", "the plan-review replay ledger's spend accounting (python -m rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay)")` (`pricing` shares the probe; the `grounding`/`grounding-t2` pair is the precedent).
- `provider_parity.py`: `:88` becomes `frozenset({"completion-verifier", "spec-alignment"})`; `:156` unions `files("rebar.llm")/eval_specs/*.eval.yaml` with `<repo_root>/.rebar/evals/*.eval.yaml`, project file winning by prompt id (mirrors `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py:71-75`); `--out` default `None` resolves to `evals_corpus_root()/"provider-parity"/"provider_parity_results.json"`; the packaged baseline `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/provider_parity_results.json` is refreshed only by passing `--out` explicitly.
- `rebar.toml`: add `[llm.evals]` with `corpus_root = "docs/experiments"`.
- `docs/env-vars.md` regenerated (`_llm_str` is a `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS` helper, `docs/env-vars.md:8`).

## Scope
`src/rebar/llm/config_readers.py`, `src/rebar/llm/config.py` (re-export lines only), `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/{__main__,ledger,tier1,tier2}.py`, `src/rebar/llm/evals/provider_parity.py`, `src/rebar/_optional.py`, `rebar.toml`, `docs/env-vars.md`, `tests/unit/evals/test_evals_corpus_root.py` (new), `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_ledger.py` and `tests/unit/test_provider_parity*.py` (default-path assertions), `tests/unit/test_optional.py` (the blurb loop already covers the new entry). Not touched: `src/rebar/_config_schema.py`, `src/rebar/_config_sources.py` (config epic), `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py`, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/fidelity_spot_eval.py` (LLM-leftovers epic), `src/rebar/llm/evals/fixture_mining/heal.py` (already `.rebar/`-relative, `heal.py:168-173,420-462`).

## Testing
Happy: `pytest tests/unit/evals -q`; in a temp client repo after `rebar init` with no config, `python -m rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay tier0 --candidate current` creates `.rebar/evals/plan-review-gate/replay/{cache,ledger.jsonl}`; in this repo a unit test asserts `evals_corpus_root() == REPO / "docs/experiments"`. Edge: `REBAR_LLM_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT=/tmp/x` wins over the file; `rebar -c llm.evals.corpus_root=y` wins over env; an absolute value is returned unchanged; with `genai_prices` blocked, `ledger.finalize` raises `OptionalDependencyError` naming `nava-rebar[evals]`; `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` and `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check` are green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git grep -n 'docs/experiments' -- src/rebar/llm/evals` returns only docstring cites (`corpus.py:5`, `legacy_v4_baseline.py:2-6`), asserted by `tests/unit/evals/test_evals_corpus_root.py::test_no_hard_coded_roots`.
- [ ] Default, env, CLI, and file precedence are proven by four parametrised cases in the new test module.
- [ ] `python -c "from rebar._optional import EXTRAS; print('evals' in EXTRAS)"` prints `True` and the ledger degrades with an `OptionalDependencyError` naming the extra.
- [ ] `python -c "from rebar.llm.evals.provider_parity import AGENTIC_SOLVERS; print(sorted(AGENTIC_SOLVERS))"` prints `['completion-verifier', 'spec-alignment']`.
- [ ] Rebar's own replay outputs are path-identical before and after (`corpus_root = "docs/experiments"` pinned; `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_corpus.py` unchanged and green).
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
